candidate_source.per_day_hash_policy: DAILY_CANDIDATE_LIST_HASH computed at freeze from rows filtered by last_processed_date == D-1

quiet_score_formula: mean(inverse_percentile(VOLUME_PACE_PRIMARY), inverse_percentile(abs(SESSION_LOW_VS_PREV_CLOSE)), inverse_percentile(SESSION_RANGE_PCT)); NA if any input missing
primary_outcome_definition: fixed 3-session structural outcome SUCCESS/FAILED_BREAKOUT/NO_LAUNCH/STRUCTURE_FAIL/UNKNOWN; primary metric SUCCESS/(SUCCESS+FAILED_BREAKOUT)
volume_primary_missing_policy: VOLUME_PACE_PRIMARY=NA, VOLUME_PRIMARY_STATUS=MISSING; no fallback to D1-full/anchor/median5
quiet_score_missing_policy: any input missing -> QUIET_SCORE=NA, QUIET_SCORE_STATUS=INCOMPLETE, QUIET_QUARTILE=NA; no mean-available/2-factor/imputation
hashing_convention: sha256(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)) excluding the self-referential hash field
